tasks.build: mkdir -p dist && cp src/* dist && deno run -A npm:elm@0.19.2-0 make src/Main.elm --output=dist/index.js
tasks.dev: deno task build && deno run -A npm:serve dist -s -C -S -n
tasks.status: deno eval "const url = 'https://api.sheets.scrap.land/status'; const bail = (msg) => { console.error(msg); Deno.exit(1) }; const res = await fetch(url, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(30000) }).catch((err) => bail('Expected graded conditions from ' + url + ', received nothing: ' + err.message + '. The service is down, unreachable, or took longer than 30s to answer.')); const text = await res.text(); let grades; try { grades = JSON.parse(text) } catch { bail('Expected graded conditions from ' + url + ', received ' + res.status + ': ' + text.slice(0, 200) + '. Source: GET /status. Is this build deployed?') } const names = Object.keys(grades); if (names.length < 13) bail('Expected at least 13 graded conditions from ' + url + ', received ' + names.length + '. Source: GET /status. A check that grades nothing passes everything.'); for (const condition of names) console.log(String(grades[condition]['0']).padStart(9), condition); const low = names.filter((condition) => !(grades[condition]['0'] >= 1)); for (const condition of low) console.error('  below 1.0:', grades[condition]['0'], condition); if (!res.ok) bail('GET /status answered ' + res.status + '. 1.0 is the minimum passing grade.')"
tasks.db:plan: deno eval --env-file=.env "const u = Deno.env.get('DATABASE_URL'); if (!u) throw new Error('Expected DATABASE_URL in .env, received nothing.'); const t = Deno.env.get('TEMP_DATABASE_URL'); const args = ['plan', '--from-dsn', u, '--to-dir', 'schema']; if (t) args.push('--temp-db-dsn', t); Deno.exit((await new Deno.Command('pg-schema-diff', { args, stdout: 'inherit', stderr: 'inherit' }).output()).code)"
tasks.db:apply: deno eval --env-file=.env "const u = Deno.env.get('DATABASE_URL'); if (!u) throw new Error('Expected DATABASE_URL in .env, received nothing.'); Deno.exit((await new Deno.Command('pg-schema-diff', { args: ['apply', '--from-dsn', u, '--to-dir', 'schema', '--allow-hazards', 'INDEX_BUILD,INDEX_DROPPED', '--skip-confirm-prompt'], stdout: 'inherit', stderr: 'inherit' }).output()).code)"
tasks.review: deno run -A npm:elm-review@2.13.5 && deno run -A npm:elm-review@2.13.5 suppress --check-after-tests
